entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Annie. How can I assist you today?
Yes, hello. I need to return something. And honestly, your website is a nightmare to navigate. I've been on hold for ages too.
I apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced. I'll do my best to make this return process as smooth as possible. What item are you looking to return?
It's the VeloBand Pulse. The… the fitness tracker. It just doesn't do what I need it to.
Okay, I understand. And when did you purchase the VeloBand Pulse?
Like, fifteen days ago. I need to get this sorted quickly. I'm really not happy with it.
Alright. I've located your order. To confirm, you want to return the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. So you are well within that window.
Ninety days? Really? Because I thought… never mind. So, what do I do now? I need a refund, not store credit.

Yes, a full refund is no problem at all. We just need to process the return. I'll generate a return label for you right away. You'll receive it via email within the next few minutes. Simply print the label, securely package the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, if possible, and drop it off at your nearest shipping location.
Okay, a label. Good. That sounds… manageable. What about the refund? When will I see that?

Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method. This typically takes 7-10 business days. You'll receive a confirmation email once the refund has been processed.

Alright, fine. Seven to ten days… Better not be longer. I was half expecting to be told I was outside some ridiculous window. Glad you have that generous 90 days thing though. What about returning a smart watch I bought ages ago?

The same 90-day return policy applies to most of our items, but there are exceptions. It's always best to check the specific return policy on the product page. Could you please provide me the order number for the smart watch and I can check that for you?
No, no. That's fine for now. Just glad I can get this VeloBand Pulse sorted. Thanks for your help. Seriously.
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could assist you today. Just to reiterate, you'll receive the return label in your email shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much! You've been great.
Thank you for calling VeloFit! Have a wonderful day.
